title: Chapter 104 Second Kill Boss
content:
Chapter 104 Second Kill Boss

"But, I..." The blue-and-white python roared angrily, even a little unclear.

She turned her huge body, and her tail kept whipping the ground around her.

The surrounding arrow towers and the outer walls that had not yet collapsed collapsed in pieces.

Stirring up countless smoke and dust.

Wang Shuo had to jump left and right like a monkey to avoid the python's attack.

Although Ayub next to him had changed his job to a general and put on chain mail, his situation was not much better than Wang Shuo's.

He was dealing with the silver boss, the tiger Cade. Every time he fought, Ayub would lose health points, ranging from dozens to hundreds.

He did not avoid the tiger's edge, but confronted Cade head-on every time.

"Human, it is your honor to die in my mouth. You have fought with me for so long, you are qualified to be remembered by me, tell me your name!"

"Bah, what are you, just a beast!" Ayub spitted with disdain, and there was blood in it.

"If you are stubborn, then go to hell!" Cade said, and with a "tiger roar", he launched a sonic attack.

This kind of attack can temporarily make people lose consciousness.

Sure enough, Ayub was stunned.

Cade showed a human smile, jumped high, and made another "pounce".

Just when the tiger claw was about to hit Ayub, he finally woke up.

"Iron wall."

This move is absolutely defensive, which can naturally offset Cade's fierce attack.

"-2"

A red number "-2" appeared above Ayub's head.

Cade showed a puzzled look. It was incredible that he didn't kill the human in front of him with a big move.

"Hmph, it's my turn!" Ayub snorted coldly, and while the tiger Cade had just fallen from the air and was unable to adjust his posture, he activated the skill "Purple Thunder Breaking Sky Strike".

Cade's back was immediately cut by the Qinglong Sword, leaving a deep wound, and the tiger bones could be seen.

"Roar!"

A wailing sound that resounded through the world came from Cade's mouth.

The battle between Ayub and Cade can be said to be extremely fierce, with every sword drawing blood and every punch hitting the flesh.

Gong Zheng's battle was not so bloody and violent.

Although the silver boss Bai Ming has an attack power of 490 points, the damage he can cause to Gong Zheng is very limited.

Each time he only loses a few dozen points of health, he does not use life potions to replenish his health.

Although the White Wolf King cannot deal with him, he cannot cause any damage to the White Wolf King either.

Because his attack power is only more than 30 points, he cannot break the defense at all.

So far, Bai Ming has not suffered any damage.

This gives people the feeling that they are playing a fake match.

Yes, they are playing a fake match.

Both sides seem to be working very hard, but there is no actual effect. Isn't this just "acting"?

On the current battlefield, Gong Zheng is relaxed, Ayub is miserable, and Wang Shuo is embarrassed.

The others can only be described as "miserable".

The golden armored warrior, because he is just a puppet, cannot be compared with the beetle boss in terms of combat flexibility. At this time, he is already missing arms and legs.

One arm is broken, and a piece of the thigh is bitten off. The durability is only 1200 points.

Wang Shuo took a look and felt heartbroken. After this battle, the golden armored warrior is probably going to be scrapped.

As for others, such as Guliji and others, they can only rely on taking drugs to constantly avoid the boss's attacks. Even so, they are also in danger.

The militia team is even worse. Two people have died, and the rest are also injured. They can only rely on taking drugs and being chased around by the boss.

At this moment, the system prompt sounded.

[Your subordinate Li Jianguo killed the level 20 bronze boss, Wild Antelope (ID: Sheep 36234 Cress]

This news is really exciting.

In this desperate battlefield, it is undoubtedly a shot of adrenaline.

Wang Shuo took a moment to take a look at the fallen Cress, and his brows relaxed a little.

This is the second boss killed.
